connector.name: FinData MCP
connector.registryDescription: Stocks, fundamentals, FRED economics, SEC filings & crypto. x402 micropayments, $0.01/call.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package findata-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sapph1re account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM wallet private key (hex, with or without 0x prefix). Any EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet. Used for x402 micropayments ($0.01/call).

env.name: FINDATA_BACKEND_URL
env.description: Override the default backend URL. Defaults to https://findata-mcp-production-1cd3.up.railway.app
